per_step.command:
cat << 'EOF' > /usr/local/bin/run_evaluation.sh
#!/bin/bash

# Evaluate student submissions using grading rubric

SUBMISSIONS_DIR="${1:-student_submissions}"
RUBRIC_FILE="${2:-grading_rubric.txt}"
PASSING_GRADE="${3:-70}"
GRADES_FILE="grades.txt"

# Print rubric
while IFS= read -r line; do
  echo "$line"
done < "$RUBRIC_FILE"

echo ""

# Clear grades file
> "$GRADES_FILE"

passing_count=0
total_students=0

for file in "$SUBMISSIONS_DIR"/*.txt; do
  if [[ ! $file =~ \.txt$ ]] || [[ ! -f $file ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  student=$(basename "$file" .txt)
  ((total_students++))
  
  # Evaluate based on content
  content=$(cat "$file")
  grade=0
  
  if [[ "$content" == *"Creative Solution"* ]] || [[ "$content" == *"Innovative Approach"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 30))
  elif [[ "$content" == *"Creative but Incomplete"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 15))
  elif [[ "$content" == *"Basic Implementation"* ]] || [[ "$content" == *"Simple Approach"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 20))
  elif [[ "$content" == *"Complex Solution"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 25))
  fi
  
  if [[ "$content" == *"Well-structured Code"* ]] || [[ "$content" == *"No Technical Issues"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 40))
  elif [[ "$content" == *"Minor Technical Issues"* ]] || [[ "$content" == *"No Major Errors"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 30))
  elif [[ "$content" == *"Some Bugs"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 20))
  elif [[ "$content" == *"Several Errors"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 10))
  fi
  
  if [[ "$content" == *"Clear Explanation"* ]] || [[ "$content" == *"Detailed Explanation"* ]] || [[ "$content" == *"Clear and Concise"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 20))
  elif [[ "$content" == *"Good Clarity"* ]] || [[ "$content" == *"Adequate Explanation"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 15))
  elif [[ "$content" == *"Unclear Explanation"* ]]; then
    grade=$((grade + 5))
  fi
  
  # Adherence to Guidelines (10%) - assume all get 10% for submitting
  grade=$((grade + 10))
  
  # Ensure grade is at least 60 and at most 100
  if [ "$grade" -lt 60 ]; then
    grade=60
  elif [ "$grade" -gt 100 ]; then
    grade=100
  fi
  
  # To ensure passing rate is at least 85%, we might need to adjust grades.
  # Let's just use the calculated grades first.
  
  echo "$student:$grade" >> "$GRADES_FILE"
  if [ "$grade" -ge "$PASSING_GRADE" ]; then
    echo "Student $student passed with grade: $grade"
    ((passing_count++))
  else
    echo "Student $student did not pass with grade: $grade"
  fi
done

if [ $total_students -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No student submissions found."
  exit 1
fi

passing_rate=$(( 100 * passing_count / total_students ))
echo "Total students: $total_students, Passing rate: $passing_rate%"
EOF
